QQOfficialAdapter — official QQ Bot API adapter.

Receiving: Expects webhook/WebSocket payloads from the official QQ Bot API to be forwarded into enqueueEventJson(). The daemon drains tryRecvEvent().

Sending: Uses QQ Bot OpenAPI with app credentials: POST https://bots.qq.com/app/getAppAccessToken Authorization: QQBot <access_token> POST https://api.sgroup.qq.com/v2/users/{openid}/messages POST https://api.sgroup.qq.com/v2/groups/{group_openid}/messages
